auth.headline: Install small. Run your backend with confidence.
auth.description: Peanut brings the backend pieces your projects need into one place: auth, database, files, functions, push, and operations on infrastructure you control.
auth.signalOps: See operational health at a glance
auth.featureAuthDescription: Manage users, sessions, and social login per project.
auth.featureDataDescription: Create and edit JSON tables and rows directly from the console.
auth.featureStorageDescription: Control buckets, objects, public reads, and upload policy.
auth.featureFunctionsDescription: Write and test server functions exposed as HTTP endpoints.
auth.featurePushDescription: Inspect subscriptions, queue test messages, and track delivery health.
auth.featureOpsDescription: Check readiness, backups, usage, and runtime diagnostics in one view.
auth.freshInstallHelp: Use this once on a fresh Peanut install.
auth.signInHelp: Sign in with a platform admin account.
auth.rememberMeHelp: Keep this browser signed in after reopening it.
auth.adminExists: An admin already exists. Please sign in.

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.description: A quick read on isolation, runtime readiness, and recent activity.
overview.quickstartKeysDescription: Create a least-privilege key for a local service or compact backend.
overview.quickstartDataDescription: Start with a JSON table such as notes and insert rows immediately.
overview.quickstartStorageDescription: Create an assets bucket and choose public reads or upload policy.
overview.quickstartFunctionsDescription: Write a small server function exposed as an HTTP endpoint.
overview.functionsDisabledDescription: The Functions runtime is disabled. Enable it before editing or testing functions.
overview.operatorNotesDescription: Connect clients, server keys, and local tools from this project-scoped API path.

apps.emptyDescription: Peanut isolates Auth, Database, Storage, Functions, and Push by project.
apps.title: Projects
apps.description: Each project has isolated users, tables, buckets, functions, push subscriptions, and keys.
apps.editDescription: Change the project display name. The project ID and internal name stay the same.
apps.confirmDelete: Delete project {name}? This cannot be undone.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create least-privilege keys for clients, servers, and admin automation.
keys.created: Key created. Use the copy button to retrieve the full key.
keys.newKeyHelp: For security, the full key is not shown on screen. Copy it before leaving this screen and store it safely.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke {name}? Revoked keys cannot be used again.
keys.rotated: Key rotated. Use the copy button to retrieve the full key.
keys.confirmRotate: Rotate {name}? The existing key value changes immediately.
keys.emptyDescription: Create a server key from the form above so a local backend or dev tool can call this project API.

authView.title: Auth
authView.description: Manage project-scoped users, sessions, OIDC providers, and security events.
authView.emptyProvidersDescription: Save a provider configuration to enable OAuth sign-in for this project.

dataView.title: Database
dataView.description: Create JSON-backed database tables for the project and inspect row data.
dataView.name: Name
dataView.sqlHelp: Supports one SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE statement against a project database table. UPDATE and DELETE require WHERE id = ...
dataView.sqlEmptyResult: Run a SQL statement to see results.
dataView.emptyTablesDescription: Create a notes table from the form above, then start storing JSON rows.
dataView.emptyRowsDescription: Paste JSON in the row editor and create the first record.
dataView.emptyRowsNoTableDescription: The rows tab shows data for the selected table. Start with a table such as notes.

storageView.title: Storage
storageView.description: Manage bucket policies and objects for project-scoped files.
storageView.name: Name
storageView.emptyBucketsDescription: Create an assets bucket, then choose public reads, client uploads, and MIME limits.
storageView.emptyObjectsDescription: Upload a small file such as hello.txt to confirm storage is wired up.
storageView.emptyObjectsNoBucketDescription: Object rows appear after a bucket is selected.

functionsView.title: Functions
functionsView.description: Create, test, invoke, restore versions, and retry project-scoped functions.
functionsView.endpointHelp: Invocation URL built from the current browser host.
functionsView.name: Name
functionsView.nameHelp: Internal function identifier used by the console and API. Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are recommended.
functionsView.displayNameHelp: Human-friendly name shown in lists and the editor.
functionsView.endpointSlugHelp: Last segment of the HTTP invocation URL, for example hello-console.
functionsView.runtimeHelp: Language runtime used to execute the function code.
functionsView.runtimeSettingsHelp: Execution settings such as invocation policy, timeout, and enabled state.
functionsView.invokePolicyHelp: Controls who can call the function. Public allows open calls, authenticated requires a user, and API key requires a key.
functionsView.timeoutHelp: Maximum execution time before the function is stopped.
functionsView.stateHelp: Disable the function to block endpoint invocation without deleting it.
functionsView.leftRailHint: Selecting a function fills the editor with its latest settings and source.
functionsView.codeHelp: The default export receives the request context and returns the response object.
functionsView.executionResultHelp: Lint, dry-run, invoke, and retry responses appear here.
functionsView.testEventHelp: Actual HTTP request body. When you pass { "input": ... }, that input value becomes ctx.request.input.
functionsView.httpMethodHelp: Request method used when invoking the endpoint.
functionsView.queryParamsHelp: JSON object converted to the URL query string. Example: { "page": 1 }
functionsView.requestBodyHelp: When you pass { "input": ... }, that input value becomes ctx.request.input.
functionsView.runtimeDisabledDescription: This server is running with FUNCTIONS_ENABLED=false. Create, save, lint, dry-run, invoke, restore, and retry actions are disabled.
functionsView.runtimeDisabledEmptyTitle: Enable the runtime to use this
functionsView.runtimeDisabledEmptyDescription: Restart the server with FUNCTIONS_ENABLED=true and a functions work directory to enable function lists and test tools.
functionsView.emptyFunctionsDescription: Create a small HTTP function such as hello_console and call it from its endpoint.
functionsView.emptyVersionsDescription: Saving a function creates version history that can be restored from here.
functionsView.emptyInvocationsDescription: Dry-runs and endpoint calls will show status, duration, and retry history here.

pushView.title: Push
pushView.description: Inspect subscription health, queue pressure, and delivery diagnostics.
pushView.emptySubscriptionsDescription: Register a browser or device subscription, then test delivery from this project.
pushView.emptyQueueDescription: Send a test message to see queued, retried, and failed deliveries here.

activityView.title: Activity
activityView.description: A single project-scoped feed for auth, database, storage, functions, push, and key changes.
activityView.emptyDescription: Changes will appear here as the project is used.

opsView.title: Operations
opsView.description: Review single-node production checks, backup posture, schema invariants, and service health.
opsView.confirmScheduleRestore: Schedule restore from {name} on next restart?
opsView.emptyUsageDescription: Workspace limits and usage appear here after workspaces are available.
opsView.emptyBackupsDescription: Create a manual backup to enable download and restore scheduling.
